# 2 Baruch Chapter 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**51:1** And-it-shall-come-to-pass, when-the-day-of-reckoning has-drawn-near — and-after-that which-I-have-said-to-you-shall-come-to-pass — then will-the-shapes of-those-who-are-found-guilty be-made-more-evil-than-they-are,

**51:2** as-they-shall-also-suffer-torment then. And-also-the-glory-of-those-who-have-now-been-justified in-my-law, who-have-had-understanding in-their-life, and-who-have-planted-in-their-heart the-root-of-wisdom —

**51:3** their-splendour will-then-be-glorified in-changes, and-the-form-of-their-face will-be-turned into-the-light-of-their-beauty, that-they-may-be-able to-acquire-and-receive the-world-which-does-not-die.

**51:4** Wherefore they-who-then-come will-lament, because-they-rejected my-law and-stopped-their-ears that-they-might-not-hear wisdom or-receive understanding.

**51:5** "When-therefore they-see those-over-whom-they-are-now-exalted, but-who-shall-then-be-exalted and-glorified more-than-they, they-shall-be-transformed, the-latter into-the-splendour-of-angels, and-the-former shall-waste-away still-more in-wonder at-the-visions-and-in-the-beholding-of-the-forms.

**51:6** For-they-shall-first-behold and-afterwards depart-to-be-tormented.

**51:7** "But-those-who-have-been-saved by-their-works, and-to-whom-the-law-has-been-now-a-hope, and-understanding an-expectation, and-wisdom a-confidence —

**51:8** shall-wonders appear-to-them in-their-time? And-the-world-to-come will-be-given-to-them and-the-time-of-the-blessed-ones will-come.

**51:9** "For-that-world-which-does-not-pass-away will-come; and-the-blessing-of-those-who-are-not-taken-captive will-be-fulfilled; and-those-who-have-been-taken-captive will-be-freed.

**51:10** And-at-that-time the-habitations-of-the-rest will-be-opened, and-its-treasury-of-souls will-be-given-back; and-the-hours-of-the-night will-no-more-be-counted, nor-will-the-hours-of-the-day.

**51:11** "But-those-who-have-been-saved will-have-no-more-adversity. For-that-world-will-also-be-free-from-all-adversity.

**51:12** For-when-a-free-man goes-forth, he-does-not-go-back to-a-prison; and-when-the-blessed-ones go-forth, they-will-not-again see-sorrow.

**51:13** "For-they-will-see that-world which-is-now-invisible-to-them, and-they-will-see-a-time which-is-now-hidden-from-them.

**51:14** And-time-will-no-longer-age-them. For-in-the-heights-of-that-world-will-they-dwell, and-they-will-be-made-like-unto-the-angels, and-be-made-equal-to-the-stars.

**51:15** And-they-will-be-changed into-every-form they-desire, from-beauty-into-loveliness, and-from-light-into-the-splendour-of-glory.

**51:16** For-the-expanses-of-Paradise will-be-spread-out-before-them; and-to-them-will-be-shown the-beauty-of-the-majesty-of-the-living-beings which-are-beneath-the-throne, and-all-the-hosts-of-the-angels, who-are-now-held-fast-by-my-word, lest-they-should-appear, and-are-held-fast-by-a-command, that-they-stand-in-their-places till-their-coming."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
